name_en: WQ101 Alpha55 Range Position Volume Corr
name_zh: WQ101 Alpha55 区间位置成交量相关
formula_zh: -corr(rank(12期区间内收盘位置), rank(成交量), 6)
intuition_en: Alpha formula from WQ101 paper, adapted for 17h bars.
